abstract.t: Large-volume email senders and Email Service Providers (ESPs) use Feedback Loops (FBLs) to identify campaigns in their traffic that generate a high volume of spam complaints from recipients and to detect abuse of their services. Traditional per-message complaint reports can expose individual recipient actions, creating privacy concerns. This document specifies the "Feedback-ID" email header field, which allows senders to embed structured campaign, customer, mail-type, and sender identifiers in outbound messages. Receiving mailbox providers authenticate this header field using DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) and report aggregated spam complaint rates per identifier back to verified senders without disclosing individual recipient data.
